display.class_color_policy: fixed color-blind-safe color per COCO category

paired_image_analysis.matching: class-aware greedy matching in descending prediction-score order
paired_image_analysis.primary_ranking: Ours minus B0 image-level F1 at IoU 0.75
paired_image_analysis.secondary_ranking: Ours minus B0 image-level F1 at IoU 0.50

representative_selection.rule: six annotation-only medoids nearest fixed density-rank x overlap-rank targets
representative_selection.distance: squared Euclidean distance in empirical percentile-rank space

improvement_selection.rule: highest paired F1 deltas under the frozen ranking

failure_selection.rule: lowest paired F1 deltas under the frozen ranking
failure_selection.honest_fallback: if fewer than four negative deltas exist, retain the lowest residual cases and label their signed deltas

reporting_policy.purpose: post-hoc qualitative reporting and disclosed error analysis only
